latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.3.3 of okx-cex-smartmoney

- Added new trader analytics commands: closed-position (realized PnL) and historical order tracking.
- Major command expansion: 10 Smart Money commands now available (was 5).
- Updated authentication flow—support for both API key and OAuth, with explicit mode handling and error routing.
- Removed deprecated composite trader portrait command; users now run modular analytics commands in parallel.
- Skill description and documentation revised for improved clarity and coverage of new features.
- Upgraded CLI dependency to @okx_ai/okx-trade-cli@1.3.3.
